units.source_text: （那么，希望你有更加体面的行动吧。

en.t: Well then, I hope you will conduct yourself with a little more dignity.

units.source_text: 不管自己的立场多么例外，一点也用不着烦恼。

en.t: No matter how exceptional your own position may be, there is no need to trouble yourself over it at all.

units.source_text: 就像世间没有救助变色毛虫的义务一样，

en.t: Just as the world has no obligation to rescue a discolored caterpillar,

units.source_text: 世间同样也没有审判它的权利……）

en.t: the world likewise has no right to judge it...）
